detail.approval_note: Approved for all group entities effective 1 January 2027

capitalization_threshold.basis: Per item or per invoice line as substantiated by invoice; aligned with the de minimis safe-harbor election for taxpayers with an applicable financial statement
capitalization_threshold.below_threshold_treatment: Expense to the operating account of the cost center

detail.commitment_rule: No purchase order, contract or work start before the capex approval
detail.componentization: Buildings and locomotives are recorded by significant component with separate lives; a replaced component is derecognized at its carrying amount
detail.construction_in_progress: Project costs accumulate in 1510 until the placed-in-service memo; certificate of occupancy or documented first productive use governs

depreciation.convention: Begins the first day of the month following placed-in-service; ends the month preceding retirement or disposal

lives_months.description: Locomotives - traction motors, main generator, engine

detail.impairment: ASC 360-10 indicators assessed quarterly; recoverability by undiscounted cash flows of the asset group
detail.repairs_vs_improvements: Expenditures are capitalized only when they result in a betterment, adaptation to a new use or restoration (incl. replacement of a major component) of a unit of property; routine maintenance expected more than once in the class life is expensed (decision recorded per expenditure above the threshold)
detail.title: Property, plant and equipment capitalization and depreciation policy
